skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray with multiple opacities to determine anatomical relationships and potential metastatic patterns.
steps: Identify all distinct soft tissue densities or masses, specifically checking the lung fields and the extrathoracic soft tissues (e.g., breast shadow).
Determine the relative horizontal position of the masses; on a standard PA/AP chest radiograph, the breast tissue is located lateral to the lung parenchyma.

Correlate the spatial relationship (lateral breast mass vs. medial lung mass) with common metastatic pathways to infer the likely primary site (e.g., breast-to-lung spread) rather than assuming independent primaries or reverse spread.
